citation_entries.sentence: Our pastor at Geneva was a married man, and that much is a biographical fact.
Our teachers did write on marriage, but we cannot yet give you that teaching here.
No record here shows how ordinary people lived out their marriages.
We will not invent that to fill the silence.

text: Our pastor at Geneva was a married man, and that much is a biographical fact. Our teachers did write on marriage, but we cannot yet give you that teaching here. No record here shows how ordinary people lived out their marriages. We will not invent that to fill the silence. Would you like to hear instead how lay elders joined the pastors in church discipline?
